cards.card_text: A whole congregation of exiles All its finest treasures Its chariots and horses
cards.verse_text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Tyre, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke a covenant of brotherhood.
cards.snippet: …I will not revoke My judgment, because they delivered up a whole congregation of exiles to Edom and broke a covenant of brotherhood.

cards.card_text: While Zechariah is inside burning incense, the whole congregation is outside.
cards.verse_text: And at the hour of the incense offering, the whole congregation was praying outside.
cards.snippet: And at the hour of the incense offering, the whole congregation was praying outside.

cards.card_text: Then the men head down to Antioch, gather the congregation and deliver the letter.
cards.verse_text: So the men were sent off and went down to Antioch, where they assembled the congregation and delivered the letter.
cards.snippet: …were sent off and went down to Antioch, where they assembled the congregation and delivered the letter.

cards.card_text: On Mount Zion, you have come to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in ___.
cards.verse_text: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven.
cards.snippet: in joyful assembly, to the congregation of the firstborn, enrolled in heaven.
